judge.rationale: The candidate only produced a planning document (`.lore/dod.md`) and a standalone acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.usage-accumulation.acceptance.test.ts`), without making any implementation changes at all. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` was left untouched, meaning the tests in the new test file will immediately fail on multi-round usage accumulation. Furthermore, the unused import `SendMessageParams` in the test file would fail ESLint checks (`--max-warnings 0`). Finally, none of the required updates to `OrchestratorHooks`, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md` were performed.
